Chapter 6953: Death Reversal

Chapter 6953: Death Reversal

Apex has always been friendly and righteous. Many considered him to be the most amicable immortal.

Nonetheless, he was still one of the oldest primordial immortals and enjoyed great prestige. It has been a long time since he felt an existential threat.

“Brother, I am not trying to haggle, it is just a proposal.” Breaker bowed again.

“There is no compromise or deals today, I will destroy the Breaker branch, no one can change this.” Li Qiye shook his head; his casual words suffocated everyone.

Everyone thought that Breaker’s fate was determined. No one wanted to share the same fate by stopping Li Qiye.

“Then that’s a no to the information...” Apex took a deep breath.

“No, that’s information I want.” Li Qiye said.

“...” Apex felt indignant at the loss of control.

“I have tried my best.” He sighed and said before bowing at Breaker. He felt he had lost more than expected after this venture.

“Your time’s up. I’m afraid it won’t be a smooth journey either.” Li Qiye smiled at Breaker.

“Enough of your arrogance!” Breaker knew he could only fight to the bitter end.

“We’ll see who will die!” He raised his hand and summoned his hammer again.

Death oozed out from the cracks upon his death. He refined the heavenly pulse from his frontier, drawing out all its essence, dao powers, and life force.

“Boom!” The smell of death emanated across Heavenrealm, causing everyone to tremble.

Immortals nearby wisely activated their defense to block the death miasma. Otherwise, they would suffer terrible consequences.

As for Breaker, his body contained enough primordial energy to create worlds. Now, he accepted death and turned his everything into the death affinity.

Even Apex and Heaven’s Equal retreated rapidly since they felt threatened by this overwhelming death.

Breaker’s eyes brimmed with the light of death upon gathering enough.

“Death Reversal.” Heaven’s Equal’s expression darkened.

“His ultimate move.” Others became alarmed due to its potency.

It could erase karma at the very source, meaning it would also erase the karma owner’s existence.

“Die!” Breaker shot out countless curves and folds from his eyes, stacking up into two beams.

They penetrated all affinities until the very beginning, seeking to erase the very source of the target.
